thread:
Maya: Heads-up: samplekit's JSON mode returned an array for tool outputs and it made the fncall helper in the Node SDK choke. Anyone else see this?
Tony: Yep, ran into that in the e2e yesterday. Looks like a parity thing between node & py. Could also be auth/retry double-encoding in some flows.
Kevin: Do we have a minimal repro to share?
Maya: Minimal paste: ```json
{
  "tool_output": [ { "name": "foo", "result": {} } ]
}
``` when the schema expects an object.
Lia: Confirmed. Py SDK unwraps single-element arrays in its coercer, node leaves them as arrays -> parity issue.
Tony: I suspect the node helper `normalizeToolResult()` is too strict. Quick idea: if parsed is [obj] and schema.type === 'object' unwrap it.
Kevin: Careful with streaming + JSONMODE: sometimes we intentionally emit multiple objects. Unwrapping blindly could break that. Need a guard/flag.
Maya: Proposal: add an `allowArrayWrap` option to the SDK helper (default false). Samplekit onboarding templates can set it true to reduce friction.
Lia: :thumbsup: also update the sample app README and the SDK quickstart to call out this edge-case. Recommend `strictSchema: true` for prod.
dev-bot: deploy-status: canary build started for branch devex/sdk/normalize-array-wrap.
Tony: I'll make a PR. Local quick fix snippet: ```js
try {
  if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length === 1 && expectedType === 'object') {
    parsed = parsed[0];
  }
} catch(e) { /* fallthrough */ }
```
Kevin: Add unit tests for streaming + chunked parse to ensure we don't regressed multi-object streams.
Maya: Also we saw auth/retry causing double-encoded bodies like `body: '"[...]"'` in logs. That could be surfacing as array strings in some cases.
Lia: That's the retry wrapper stringify bug I mentioned earlier — it stringifies when injecting headers sometimes. Filed #5432 with logs.
Tony: I'll coordinate with eng-infra to make sure retry middleware doesn't stringify the request body.
Kevin: Plan recap: 1) small node helper change + tests, 2) add `allowArrayWrap` opt and samplekit default for onboarding, 3) update sampleapp README, 4) fix retry middleware to avoid double-encode.
Maya: Assigning: @Tony -> PR, @Kevin -> tests/streaming, @Lia -> docs + follow-up issue. Timeline: this week?
Tony: Aiming EOD Thu for PR, will flag if infra needs more time.
dev-bot: PR created: #7899 devex/sdk: normalize-array-wrap (Tony)
Lia: I'll update the sample app README and add a short note in the JSONMODE docs.
Maya: Thanks — if anyone finds other edge cases (nested arrays, union schemas, streaming edgecases), drop them here and tag the thread.
